描述_EN: camels and horses were used as pack animals and merchants passed their goods from oasis to oasis. the victoria and albert museum has around 700 ancient and medieval textiles recovered by stein at the beginning of the twentieth century. these fragments were brought back from central asia by the explorer and archaeologist sir marc aurel stein (1862–1943). the most notable item traded was silk. the site is part of an area now referred to as the silk road, a series of overland trade routes that crossed asia, from china to europe. the silk road was also important for the exchange of ideas – while silk textiles travelled west from china, buddhism entered china from india in this way. they are respectively of plain weave brown silk, monochrome pattern weave light brown silk, pattern unidentified, plain weave red wool, a bundle of white thread and a length of blue wool thread wrapped around a bundle of dried grass-like blades. many textile fragments were discovered here in the remains of a fort held by the tibetans during their domination of the southern taklamakan in the 8th century ad. some are silk while others are made from the wool of a variety of different animals. these five pieces of textile have been stitched together with a numbered label. the textiles range in date from the second century bc to the twelfth century ad. these textile pieces were recovered from the site of miran fort on the eastern verge of the taklamakan desert.
描述_ZN: 年，骆驼和马被用作驮运动物，商人们在绿洲之间传递他们的货物。 年，维多利亚和阿尔伯特博物馆有大约700件古代和中世纪的纺织品，是斯坦在20世纪初找到的。 年，这些碎片被探险家和考古学家Marc Aurel Stein先生（1862-1943）从中亚带回来。 年，最引人注目的贸易项目是丝绸。 年：该遗址是现在被称为 "丝绸之路 "的地区的一部分，这是一系列横跨亚洲、从中国到欧洲的陆上贸易路线。 年：丝绸之路对思想交流也很重要--当丝绸纺织品从中国向西运输时，佛教也通过这种方式从印度进入中国。 它们分别是平纹棕色丝绸，单色图案编织的浅棕色丝绸，图案不明，平纹红色羊毛，一束白色的线和一束蓝色的羊毛线缠绕着一束干草状的叶片。 许多纺织品碎片是在公元8世纪西藏人统治塔克拉玛干南部期间的堡垒遗址中发现的。 有些是丝绸，有些则是由各种不同动物的羊毛制成。 这五件纺织品被缝合在一起，上面有一个编号的标签。 这些纺织品的年代从公元前二世纪到公元十二世纪不等。 这些纺织品是在塔克拉玛干沙漠东部边缘的米兰堡遗址中发现的。
